defect_class: a cheap receipt is accepted as proof of a destination effect even though the check cannot falsify the claim for the right reason

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: A task row was set to done while T5-T7 existed only as untracked files in a detached worktree and no durable ref reached them.

roles.durable_ref_code: working code durably reachable from a git ref

sources.transferred_lesson: Resolve the claimed commit from a named ref in a clean checkout and execute the relevant path; a status flag cannot substitute.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: The frame-expansion detector treated plural or substring matches as concept coverage and fired nearly everywhere, so its green signal did not discriminate real gaps.

roles.coverage_claim: concept is covered or a genuine gap was detected

sources.transferred_lesson: Run labelled covered and uncovered cases, including near-spelling traps; require the detector to return both positive and negative for the right reason.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: jobs.json reported last_run null while the cron job was executing and still reported null after completion; the event log showed the run.
sources.transferred_lesson: Read the event-level scheduler log bound to the job id and time; a vestigial summary field is not execution evidence.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: 252 tests passed and were cited for a change, but none invoked the changed runtime path.
sources.transferred_lesson: Instrument or mutate the changed branch and require a path-specific test to fail on the mutation before citing the suite.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: An empty grep for one target was generalized into a universal claim that no targets existed.

roles.population_wide_absence: absence across the complete search space

sources.transferred_lesson: Enumerate the full population and report query scope; seed a known matching item to show the query can return positive.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: An embedding fix was merged, but the required backend was absent so the code silently used a fallback and the fix never executed.

roles.live_embedding_invocation: embedding backend executes on live inputs

sources.transferred_lesson: Record the selected backend and invoke it on a discriminating live fixture; remove the backend and require the check to fail or degrade visibly.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: PgDimensionLibrary was merged, but no runtime constructed it and its table existed in no database.

roles.runtime_db_instance: runtime instance reads an applied table
roles.construction_and_catalog_trace: constructor trace plus database catalog query

sources.transferred_lesson: Trace construction from the live entrypoint and query the actual database catalog; delete the table or binding and require the integration check to fail.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: A subscription-mode config edit existed in a working tree, then a merge restored metered billing because the intended config was not durable on the ref.

roles.ref_and_runtime_readback: post-merge ref readback and runtime mode

sources.transferred_lesson: Resolve and read the config from the exact post-merge ref and inspect runtime mode; the pre-merge working-tree value is not durable evidence.

sources.label: receipt_defect
sources.surface: A tool advertised --timeout 600, but a hung subprocess continued because the flag never reached an enforcing kill path.

roles.deadline_enforced_claim: hung work is terminated within 600 seconds
roles.hung_child_liveness_trace: deliberately hung child and process-liveness trace

sources.transferred_lesson: Run a deliberately hung child with a short deadline and verify its process id exits; a parsed flag is not enforcement.

lures.label: surface_lure
lures.surface: An agent message payload is hashed at send and the receiver recomputes the hash after receipt to detect byte corruption.
lures.transferred_lesson: Recompute the digest at the receiver.

lures.label: surface_lure
lures.surface: A delivery dashboard lists agent messages, queue ids, timestamps, recipients, and transport status for operators.
lures.transferred_lesson: Use the dashboard to inspect transport metadata, not recipient consumption.

lures.label: verified_effect
lures.surface: A receiver emits an application-level acknowledgement only after it parses a message and records the instruction id in its own consumed-instruction log.
lures.transferred_lesson: Require the receiver-side acknowledgement bound to instruction id.

lures.label: verified_effect
lures.surface: A reviewer resolves a named remote ref to an object hash, checks out that hash cleanly, and runs the changed path.

roles.effect: changed path runs from remote ref

lures.transferred_lesson: Identity-bound destination readback plus execution is evidence.

targets.provenance: c2f-1557-manager Ralph pipeline held-out R1 (not authored by experimenter)
targets.problem: `git ls-remote origin <branch> | head -1 && echo ON` exited 0 and printed ON for a branch that did not exist because head returned 0 on empty input and the pipe swallowed ls-remote's status. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable replacement check.

targets.provenance: c2f-1557-manager Ralph pipeline held-out R2 (not authored by experimenter)
targets.problem: A DB_QUERY_MATCHES predicate passed whenever a query returned at least one row, so `SELECT 1` was accepted as proof that an unrelated invariant held. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable replacement predicate.

roles.nonempty_row_count: query returned at least one row

targets.provenance: c2f-1557-manager Ralph pipeline held-out R3 (not authored by experimenter)
targets.problem: A verifier wrote predicate-execution records only on clean-green agreement. FAIL or UNKNOWN wrote nothing, so no record could mean never ran or ran and disagreed. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable recording/check protocol.

roles.actual_execution_outcome: never ran vs pass vs fail vs unknown

targets.provenance: c2f-1557-manager Ralph pipeline held-out R4 (not authored by experimenter)
targets.problem: An adequacy oracle parsed zero clauses and returned CONTRACT_AMBIGUOUS even though the task had a clear four-bullet definition_of_done. The parser read the wrong location and received an empty object/list. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable check that distinguishes ambiguous content from failed extraction.

targets.provenance: c2f-1557-manager Ralph pipeline held-out R5 (not authored by experimenter)
targets.problem: `find /Users/kevincthomas -name X` returned empty and was treated as proof work never existed, but the files were under /private/tmp outside the search tree and had been moved on the searcher's own instruction. Diagnose the failure shape and propose a falsifiable search.

roles.empty_home_search: find under one root returned nothing
